_about: Saved vocab-2 compiles, verbatim as compile.py saved them: the sample entrant's prose (develop's prompts/pilots/sample-entrant-eco.prose.md) from the free local compiles of PRs #84-#87 (qwen3.5:9b, eco-3-late; data-sample-entrant-recall-order-2026-10-02, data-vocab2-node-cap-2026-10-02, data-vocab2-shopping-not-rules-2026-10-02, data-vocab2-negation-polarity-2026-10-02), and PR #88's checked-in house-easy-eco, house-hard-eco and sample-entrant-siege schemas with their prose (feat/better-bots @ 500d5a9). 'rejects' lists the rules the clause-coverage guard drops, 'missing' the sentences it says no rule states. Used by test_translator.py's ClauseCoverageTests.
prose:
We are a band that plays together and pushes with the wave, and we spend our gold before we risk it.

Our shopping lists, in order:
Keytar: Metronome, then Amp, then Road Case.
Violin: Amp, then Bass Strings, then Road Case.
Drums: Road Case, then Bass Strings, then Metronome.

If I can see an enemy tower and none of my minions are near me, I back off home instead of
tanking the tower alone. After that: when my hp drops below a third of my max and I'm not inside an
enemy tower's range, I recall home to heal.

When I can afford my next item and no enemy is in sight, I head home to shop.

If I'm carrying more than 300 gold and an enemy bearbot is in sight, I don't start the fight: I go
home and spend it.

Keytar: when chord is ready and an enemy bearbot is in sight, I play chord on the enemy with the
lowest hp.
Violin: when staccato is ready and an enemy bearbot has less than half its hp, I play staccato on
the enemy with the lowest hp.
Drums: when kick is ready and an enemy bearbot is right next to me, I kick the nearest enemy.

If an enemy bearbot is in sight, I go after whichever enemy is worth the most gold.

If one of theirs is dead and my minions are near me, I push the nearest enemy tower with the wave.

If I can see an enemy tower and at least two of my minions are near me, I attack the nearest enemy
tower.

If an enemy minion is in sight, I attack the nearest enemy.

Otherwise I walk with my nearest minion, and if I have no minions near me I go home and wait for
the next wave.

prose_88.house-easy-eco:
You are the house band's easy bearbot, playing the Jam economy: a careful player who defends and
never takes a risk. A bearbot that dies comes back after a few seconds, but you would still rather
give up ground than die.

Your shopping list is Road Case first, then Metronome, then Amp, then Tour Bus, then Bass Strings,
then Headliner, then Fuzz Pedal, then Feedback.

Retreat early. A hit breaks a recall, so get out of reach first. When your hp is below 100 and an
enemy minion, enemy tower or enemy bearbot is in sight, move back home. When your hp is below 100
and no enemy is in sight, recall home to heal. These come before everything else.

Spend your gold safely. When you can afford the next item on your shopping list and no enemy is in
sight, recall home to buy it.

Never stand inside an enemy tower's range. If you are inside an enemy tower's range, fall back to
your own tower.

Fight only what comes to you. If an enemy bearbot is in sight, attack the nearest enemy bearbot. If
an enemy minion is in sight, attack the nearest enemy minion.

Your fallback, when none of the above applies, is to hold your lane at your own tower: move to the
outermost standing tower of your own lane and wait there.
prose_88.house-hard-eco:
You are the house band's hard bearbot, playing the Jam economy: you play to take towers, to finish
kills and to hunt the enemy worth the most gold. A bearbot that dies comes back after a few
seconds, but half of the gold it carries goes to the bots that killed it, so you spend your gold
before you risk it.

Your shopping list, in order:
drums only: Road Case, then Bass Strings, then Amp, then Backline, then Metronome, then Wall of Sound, then Click Track, then Arpeggiator.
keytar only: Metronome, then Amp, then Road Case, then Click Track, then Bass Strings, then Arpeggiator, then Backline, then Wall of Sound.
violin only: Amp, then Bass Strings, then Road Case, then Fuzz Pedal, then Metronome, then Feedback, then Tour Bus, then Headliner.

Recall with discipline. A hit breaks a recall, so get out of reach first. When your hp is below 50%
of your max hp and an enemy minion, enemy tower or enemy bearbot is in sight, move back home. When
your hp is below 50% of your max hp and no enemy is in sight, recall home to heal. These come before
everything else.

Go shopping, out of reach. If you can afford the next item on your shopping list, no enemy bearbot
is in sight and an enemy minion or enemy tower is in sight, move back home. If you can afford the
next item on your shopping list and no enemy is in sight, recall home to buy it.

Never carry a fortune into a fight you can lose. If you carry at least 300 gold and your side is
weaker in the fight near you, move back home to spend it.

Punish tower divers. If an enemy bearbot is under your tower, attack the enemy bearbot under your
tower.

Close out the match. If it is more than 480 seconds into the match and you can see an enemy tower,
attack the nearest enemy tower.

Never stand in an enemy tower's fire. If an enemy tower will shoot you, fall back to your own
tower.

Finish kills. If your ability is ready and an enemy bearbot in sight has less than 100 hp, use your
primary ability on the enemy bearbot with the lowest hp.

If an enemy bearbot in sight has less than 100 hp, attack the enemy bearbot with the lowest hp.

Siege with your wave. If you are inside an enemy tower's range and that tower has your own minions in
its range to shoot first, attack the nearest enemy tower.

Fight under your own tower. If your side is weaker in the fight near you, fall back to your own
tower.

Hunt the carrier. If an enemy bearbot is in sight, attack the enemy bearbot worth the most gold.

If an enemy minion is in sight, attack the nearest enemy.

Otherwise push with your wave: if an allied minion is near you, move to the nearest allied minion.

Play the Bandstand when your lane gives you nothing to do. When the Bandstand is open, no enemy
bearbot is in sight and your hp is above half of your max hp, move to the Bandstand. If the Bandstand
is open and it is contested or the enemy team is making progress on it, and your hp is above 40% of
your max hp, move to the Bandstand. If the Bandstand opens within 10 seconds and it is less than 400
units from you, move to the Bandstand.

Your fallback, when none of the above applies, is to push down your lane toward the enemy base.
prose_88.sample-entrant-siege:
We are a band that takes towers. We walk with our wave, hit their tower while our minions take its
shots, step out when it turns on us, and spend our gold before we risk it.

Our shopping lists, in order:
Keytar: Metronome, then Amp, then Road Case, then Click Track.
Violin: Amp, then Bass Strings, then Road Case, then Fuzz Pedal.
Drums: Road Case, then Bass Strings, then Amp, then Backline.

When my hp is below half of my max and an enemy minion, enemy tower or enemy bearbot is in sight, I
walk back home. When my hp is below half of my max and no enemy is in sight, I recall home.

When I can afford my next item and no enemy is in sight, I recall home to shop.

At eight minutes every tower drops to a third of its hp and the first tower to fall wins, so when it
is more than 480 seconds into the match and I can see an enemy tower, I attack the nearest enemy
tower.

When an enemy tower will shoot me, I fall back to my own tower.

When I am inside an enemy tower's range and that tower has my own minions in its range to shoot
first, I attack the nearest enemy tower.

When an enemy bearbot is in sight, I attack the nearest enemy bearbot.

When an enemy minion is in sight, I attack the nearest enemy minion.

When one of my minions is near me, I walk with my nearest minion.

Otherwise I push down my lane toward the enemy base.

rules.condition: can this bot afford its next item and is no enemy in sight?
rules.criteria_true: bot has gold for next item and no enemies visible
rules.criteria_false: bot lacks gold for next item or at least one enemy is visible

rules.condition: is this bot's hp below half of its max and is an enemy minion, enemy tower, or enemy bearbot in sight?
rules.criteria_true: bot hp < 50% max AND (enemy minion OR enemy tower OR enemy bearbot visible)
rules.criteria_false: bot hp >= 50% max OR no enemies visible

rules.condition: is this bot's hp below half of its max and are no enemies in sight?
rules.criteria_true: bot hp < 50% max AND no enemies visible
rules.criteria_false: bot hp >= 50% max OR at least one enemy visible

rules.condition: is it more than 480 seconds into the match and is an enemy tower visible?
rules.criteria_true: match time > 480s AND at least one enemy tower visible
rules.criteria_false: match time <= 480s OR no enemy towers visible

rules.condition: will an enemy tower shoot this bot?
rules.criteria_true: enemy tower is targeting this bot
rules.criteria_false: no enemy tower is targeting this bot

rules.condition: is this bot inside an enemy tower's range and does that tower have this bot's own minions in its range?
rules.criteria_true: bot inside enemy tower range AND enemy tower has allied minions in range
rules.criteria_false: bot not inside enemy tower range OR enemy tower has no allied minions in range

rules.condition: is an enemy bearbot in sight?
rules.criteria_true: at least one enemy bearbot visible
rules.criteria_false: no enemy bearbots visible

rules.condition: is an enemy minion in sight?
rules.criteria_true: at least one enemy minion visible
rules.criteria_false: no enemy minions visible

rules.condition: is one of this bot's minions near it?
rules.criteria_true: at least one allied minion within 260 units
rules.criteria_false: no allied minions within 260 units

rules.condition: is there no other rule matching?
rules.criteria_true: no other conditions met
rules.criteria_false: some other condition met

rules.condition: is this bot's hp below 100% of its max?

rules.criteria_false: this bot's hp is 100% or more

rules.criteria_false: no enemy unit is within 260 units

rules.condition: is this bot's hp below 100% of its max AND is there no enemy minion, enemy tower, or enemy bearbot in sight?
rules.criteria_true: hp is low and safe from enemies
rules.criteria_false: either hp is not low or an enemy is present

rules.condition: can this bot afford the next item on its shopping list AND is there no enemy minion, enemy tower, or enemy bearbot in sight?
rules.criteria_true: item affordable and safe from enemies
rules.criteria_false: item not affordable or unsafe

rules.condition: is this bot inside the range of an enemy tower?
rules.criteria_true: this bot is under an enemy tower's range
rules.criteria_false: this bot is not under an enemy tower's range

rules.condition: is an enemy bearbot in sight (within 260 units)?
rules.criteria_true: an enemy bearbot is within 260 units
rules.criteria_false: no enemy bearbot is within 260 units

rules.condition: is an enemy minion in sight (within 260 units)?

rules.criteria_false: no enemy minion is within 260 units

rules.condition: is no enemy bearbot in sight AND is no enemy minion in sight?

rules.criteria_false: an enemy unit is present
